title: Reports
subtitle: Your team, across projects.
invalid: Choose a valid date range of up to 366 days and at least one report source.
invalidUrl: This dashboard link has invalid settings. Reset the view to choose a valid scope.
sourcesHint: Saved project reports provide field mappings only. Their task filters are not carried over.
emptyHint: Create a project report that compares two ordinary duration fields, then return here. No special hours column or planning week is required.
coverageHint: Current values are grouped by the selected task date. They are not a daily record of when work happened. Shared tasks count once, using their home project's fields.

projectLimit: Choose up to 20 projects. Additional projects are not included until selected.

cards.capacityUnconfigured: Unknown: time off settings are not configured
cards.paired: Actual/estimate {{percent}} on {{paired}} of {{eligible}} tasks with both values

trend.caption: Columns place the current task cohort by task date; they are not dated attendance or time logs.

categories.title: Actual by category
categories.totalUnknown: Total actual is unknown, so shares are not shown.
categories.totalZero: Total actual is zero, so shares are not shown.

method: Plan and Actual are full sums by primary assignee; Actual/estimate % uses only tasks that have both values.

coverage.actual: Actual: {{filled}} of {{tasks}} tasks filled · {{missing}} missing · {{nulls}} empty · {{zero}} zero

sourceMissing: A selected report is no longer available. Reset the view or choose another source; the report was not replaced automatically.
unassignedRatio: Recorded/available is unavailable because some recorded time has no matching person in the capacity scope.
askAdminSchedules: Ask a workspace administrator to configure working schedules.

accuracy.title: Estimation accuracy by period
accuracy.help: Actual ÷ estimate on the tasks that have both. 100% is a perfect estimate; above means the work took longer than estimated, below means it took less. Green is within 10%, amber within 25%.
accuracy.missChange: Average miss: {{early}} in the earlier half, {{late}} in the later half
accuracy.noPairs: No task has both an estimate and an actual in this period
accuracy.caption: Based on current values of tasks due in each period; it shows how well estimates match results, not how much was worked or how good the work was.

load.title: Hours worked vs available
load.help: Recorded hours ÷ hours the person could have worked that week (working hours minus time off and holidays). 95% and more is good, 90–95% is fine, below 90% is highlighted. Over 100% means more was recorded than planned working time. A dash means no data: the person was away all week or has no working hours set.
load.partial: * Part of the week was time off or a holiday, so the figure is measured against fewer hours and is less precise.
load.cellPartial: {{worked}} recorded of {{available}} available ({{percent}}). Part week: {{away}} of time off or holidays out of {{scheduled}} scheduled, so this is less precise.
load.unknown: No working hours set for this person: no data
load.averageTitle: Average over the weeks with data
load.noFact: No recorded duration is available for this period.

unfinished.title: Unfinished tasks
unfinished.help: Tasks still to do or in progress, by the week of their due date. Tasks whose week is already over are overdue and listed per person.
unfinished.none: No unfinished tasks in this range
